eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 8:21 PM on AUG 16, 2023 Effective until 6:21 AM AUG 17, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Phoenix Police Department.  This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. Phoenix Police Department is looking for Brandon Collins, a nineteen year old white male, last seen riding a blue scooter with black wheels near Ray Road and Rock Wren Road in Phoenix. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
